title.en: Fayol's principles: division of work to remuneration

hook.en: Taylor looked at the shop floor; Henri Fayol, a French mining engineer, looked at the whole organisation from the top. His 14 principles are still used in every office and factory.

body.en: Division of work: work is divided into small tasks for specialisation. Authority and responsibility must be balanced. Discipline means obeying rules and the employment agreement, with good superiors and fair penalties. Unity of command: each employee gets orders from one superior only.

title.en: On the board: unity of command vs unity of direction

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Unity of command: one subordinate, one boss. Draw one boss above one worker.
If two bosses give orders to one worker, we get dual subordination and confusion.
Unity of direction: one head and one plan for each group of activities with the same objective.
A second product gets its own head and its own plan.

body.en: Unity of direction: one head and one plan for a group of activities with the same objective. Subordination of individual interest to general interest: the interest of the organisation comes first. Remuneration of employees should be just and fair to both employees and the organisation.

points.en: Unity of direction: one head, one plan
Subordination of individual interest to general interest

mnemonic.en: "Dad And Daughter Use Umbrellas So Rain Can't Soak Our Expensive Silk Indian Embroidery" (D A D U U S R C S O E S I E)

problem.en: In a Mangaluru courier company, a delivery boy is told by the branch manager to deliver a parcel first, and by the accounts manager to collect cash first. He is confused and both jobs are delayed. Identify the principle violated and suggest a remedy.

steps.en: The delivery boy is getting orders from two superiors.
This is dual subordination, which violates unity of command.
Remedy: he should report to one superior only, who passes on all instructions.

answer.en: Unity of command is violated; each employee should receive orders from one superior only.
